    -- 逻辑删除标记：0-未删除 1-已删除

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth_token (
    -- 主键ID，雪花算法生成
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT 'Token ID',
    
    -- 租户标识，用于多租户数据隔离
    tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '租户ID',
    
    -- 用户ID，关联auth_user表
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
    
    -- Token类型：ACCESS-访问令牌 REFRESH-刷新令牌
    token_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Token类型',
    
    -- Token值，实际的JWT字符串或Opaque Token
    token_value VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Token值',
    
    -- JWT ID，JWT的唯一标识符，用于撤销和黑名单
    jti VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE COMMENT 'JWT ID',
    
    -- Token过期时间，超过此时间Token失效
    expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL COMMENT '过期时间',
    
    -- 撤销标记：0-正常 1-已撤销
    revoked TINYINT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '撤销标记',
    
    -- 撤销时间，记录Token被撤销的时间
    revoked_at TIMESTAMP COMMENT '撤销时间',
    
    -- 设备ID，标识Token所属设备
    device_id VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '设备ID',
    
    -- 客户端IP地址，记录Token签发时的客户端IP
    client_ip VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '客户端IP',
    
    -- User-Agent，记录客户端类型和版本
    user_agent VARCHAR(500) COMMENT 'User-Agent',
    
    -- 创建时间
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
    
    -- 索引：租户+用户查询
    INDEX idx_tenant_user (tenant_id, user_id),
    
    -- 唯一索引：JWT ID查询
    UNIQUE INDEX idx_jti (jti),
    
    -- 索引：过期时间查询，用于清理过期Token
    INDEX idx_expires_at (expires_at),
    
    -- 索引：设备ID查询，用于设备管理
    INDEX idx_device_id (device_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Token表'

CREATE PROCEDURE IF NOT EXISTS add_tenant_id_if_not_exists(IN p_table VARCHAR(128), IN p_after_col VARCHAR(128))
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.TABLES
        WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = p_table
    ) AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
        WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = p_table AND COLUMN_NAME = 'tenant_id'
    ) THEN
        SET @sql = CONCAT('ALTER TABLE `', p_table, '` ADD COLUMN `tenant_id` VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT ''租户ID（多租户隔离）'' AFTER `', p_after_col, '`')
PREPARE stmt FROM @sql
EXECUTE stmt
DEALLOCATE PREPARE stmt
SET @idx_sql = CONCAT('CREATE INDEX `idx_', p_table, '_tenant_id` ON `', p_table, '` (`tenant_id`)')
PREPARE idx_stmt FROM @idx_sql
EXECUTE idx_stmt
DEALLOCATE PREPARE idx_stmt
END IF
END
DELIMITER

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sys_tenant` (
    `id`              BIGINT       NOT NULL                 COMMENT '主键ID（雪花算法）',
    `tenant_code`     VARCHAR(64)  NOT NULL                 COMMENT '租户编码（全局唯一，作为租户上下文ID）',
    `tenant_name`     VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL                 COMMENT '租户名称',
    `admin_user_id`   VARCHAR(64)  DEFAULT NULL             COMMENT '租户管理员用户ID',
    `package_code`    VARCHAR(64)  DEFAULT NULL             COMMENT '套餐标识',
    `expire_time`     DATETIME     DEFAULT NULL             COMMENT '有效期至（NULL表示长期有效）',
    `status`          VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL                 COMMENT '租户状态（ACTIVE/DISABLED/FROZEN/DEACTIVATED/ARCHIVED）',
    `max_users`       INT          DEFAULT NULL             COMMENT '最大用户数（NULL表示不限制）',
    `max_storage_mb`  INT          DEFAULT NULL             COMMENT '最大存储容量MB（NULL表示不限制）',
    `remark`          VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL             COMMENT '备注',
    `create_time`     DATETIME     NOT NULL                 COMMENT '创建时间',
    `update_time`     DATETIME     NOT NULL                 COMMENT '更新时间',
    `version`         INT          NOT NULL DEFAULT 0       COMMENT '乐观锁版本号',
    `deleted`         INT          NOT NULL DEFAULT 0       COMMENT '逻辑删除标记（0-未删除，1-已删除）',
    PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
    UNIQUE KEY `uk_sys_tenant_code` (`tenant_code`),
    KEY `idx_sys_tenant_status` (`status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='租户基础信息与生命周期表（平台级元数据）'

DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE `enforce_department_tenant_integrity`()
BEGIN
    DECLARE seed_dept_count INT DEFAULT 0
DECLARE seed_admin_count INT DEFAULT 0
DECLARE other_user_reference_count INT DEFAULT 0
DECLARE role_dept_reference_count INT DEFAULT 0
DECLARE unassigned_dept_count INT DEFAULT 0

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO seed_dept_count
    FROM `sys_dept`
    WHERE `id` = 1
      AND `parent_id` = 0
      AND `ancestors` = '0'
      AND `name` = 'Apex 科技'
      AND `tenant_id` IS NULL

IF seed_dept_count = 1 THEN
        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO seed_admin_count
        FROM `sys_user`
        WHERE `id` = 1
          AND `open_id` = 'admin-openid'
          AND `username` = 'admin'
          AND `dept_id` = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO other_user_reference_count
        FROM `sys_user`
        WHERE `dept_id` = 1
          AND NOT (`id` = 1 AND `open_id` = 'admin-openid' AND `username` = 'admin')

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO role_dept_reference_count
        FROM `sys_role_dept`
        WHERE `dept_id` = 1

IF seed_admin_count = 1
                AND other_user_reference_count = 0
                AND role_dept_reference_count = 0 THEN
            UPDATE `sys_user`
            SET `dept_id` = NULL
            WHERE `id` = 1
              AND `open_id` = 'admin-openid'
              AND `username` = 'admin'
              AND `dept_id` = 1

DELETE FROM `sys_dept`
            WHERE `id` = 1
              AND `parent_id` = 0
              AND `ancestors` = '0'
              AND `name` = 'Apex 科技'
              AND `tenant_id` IS NULL

ELSE
            SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
                SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'V19 cannot safely remove the legacy seed department because its references are ambiguous'
END IF
END IF

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO unassigned_dept_count
    FROM `sys_dept`
    WHERE `tenant_id` IS NULL

IF unassigned_dept_count > 0 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
            SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'V19 requires every department to have an explicit tenant_id before migration'
END IF

END//
DELIMITER
CALL `enforce_department_tenant_integrity`()
DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS `enforce_department_tenant_integrity`

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sys_api_call_log`
(
    `id`               BIGINT       NOT NULL COMMENT '主键ID（雪花算法）',
    `service_name`     VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '目标服务名称，如 wechat / chuanglan / baidu-image / face-analysis',
    `method`           VARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL COMMENT 'HTTP请求方法，如 GET / POST / PUT / DELETE',
    `path`             VARCHAR(500)          COMMENT '请求路径（不含host），如 /api/v1/login',
    `url`              VARCHAR(2000)         COMMENT '完整请求URL（包含query参数）',
    `request_headers`  TEXT                  COMMENT '请求头（JSON格式），敏感字段如Authorization/ApiKey等会被脱敏',
    `request_body`     MEDIUMTEXT            COMMENT '请求体（超过默认限制时截断），二进制用base64编码',
    `response_status`  VARCHAR(10)           COMMENT 'HTTP响应状态码，如 200 / 404 / 500。无响应时为 null',
    `response_headers` TEXT                  COMMENT '响应头（JSON格式）',
    `response_body`    MEDIUMTEXT            COMMENT '响应体（超过默认限制时截断）',
    `execution_time`   BIGINT                COMMENT '执行耗时（毫秒），从发起请求到收到响应的时间',
    `status`           INT(1)       NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '调用状态：0-成功（HTTP 2xx） 1-客户端错误（4xx） 2-服务端错误（5xx） 3-网络异常',
    `error_msg`        TEXT                  COMMENT '错误信息，异常时记录异常的堆栈前3行',
    `trace_id`         VARCHAR(100)          COMMENT '链路追踪ID，关联前端请求与后端API调用',
    `create_time`      DATETIME     NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
    `update_time`      DATETIME     NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间',
    `version`          INT(10)      NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '版本号（保留字段）',
    `deleted`          INT(1)       NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '逻辑删除标记：0-未删除 1-已删除',
    PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
    INDEX `idx_service_name` (`service_name`),
    INDEX `idx_path` (`path`(100)),
    INDEX `idx_status` (`status`),
    INDEX `idx_trace_id` (`trace_id`),
    INDEX `idx_create_time` (`create_time`),
    INDEX `idx_service_status_create` (`service_name`, `status`, `create_time`)
) ENGINE = InnoDB
  DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4
  COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci
  COMMENT = 'API调用日志表（记录对外部HTTP服务的每次调用详情）'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sys_domain_event_outbox` (
  `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
  `event_id` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '领域事件唯一标识',
  `event_class` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '领域事件 Java 类型',

-- payload: 事件 JSON 负载，包含事件携带的全部业务数据。
  `payload` LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '事件 JSON 负载',

-- PENDING: 待投递 / PROCESSING: 投递中 / DELIVERED: 已投递 / DEAD: 死信。
  `status` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' COMMENT 'PENDING/PROCESSING/DELIVERED/DEAD',

-- attempts: 已失败重试次数，达到上限后移入 DEAD。
  `attempts` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '已失败次数',

-- next_attempt_at: 指数退避后的下次重试时间点。
  `next_attempt_at` DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) COMMENT '下次投递时间',

-- locked_by: 投递实例的唯一标识（如实例 ID），用于多实例互斥领取。
  `locked_by` VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '投递实例令牌',

  `locked_at` DATETIME(6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '领取时间',

-- last_error: 最近一次投递失败的错误摘要（脱敏后），用于故障排查。
  `last_error` VARCHAR(1000) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '最近一次错误摘要',

  `created_at` DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) COMMENT '创建时间',

-- delivered_at: 投递成功完成后记录，用于判断事件投递延迟。
  `delivered_at` DATETIME(6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '完成时间',

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),

-- event_id 全局唯一，防止同一事件重复写入。
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_outbox_event_id` (`event_id`),

-- 调度器核心查询：按状态和下次尝试时间领取待投递事件。
-- id 作为第三列确保相同优先级事件按 FIFO 顺序处理。
  KEY `idx_outbox_dispatch` (`status`, `next_attempt_at`, `id`),

-- 定位超时未完成的事件（locked 状态过久，需重新调度）。
  KEY `idx_outbox_locked` (`status`, `locked_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='领域事件可靠投递表'

CREATE TABLE oauth2_authorization (
    id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '授权记录唯一标识',
    registered_client_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的客户端ID(外键)',
    principal_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '用户标识(OpenID或用户名)',
    authorization_grant_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '授权类型: authorization_code, client_credentials, password, refresh_token',
    authorized_scopes VARCHAR(1000) COMMENT '已授权的作用域(逗号分隔)',
    attributes TEXT COMMENT '授权属性(JSON对象,存储额外元数据)',
    state VARCHAR(500) COMMENT 'OAuth2 state参数(防CSRF)',
    
    -- 授权码相关字段
    authorization_code_value TEXT COMMENT '授权码值(SHA-256哈希后存储)',
    authorization_code_issued_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '授权码签发时间',
    authorization_code_expires_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '授权码过期时间(通常5分钟)',
    authorization_code_metadata TEXT COMMENT '授权码元数据(JSON)',
    
    -- 访问令牌相关字段
    access_token_value TEXT COMMENT '访问令牌值(JWT或Opaque Token)',
    access_token_issued_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '访问令牌签发时间',
    access_token_expires_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '访问令牌过期时间(通常2小时)',
    access_token_metadata TEXT COMMENT '访问令牌元数据(JSON)',
    access_token_type VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '访问令牌类型: Bearer',
    access_token_scopes VARCHAR(1000) COMMENT '访问令牌作用域',
    
    -- OIDC ID Token相关字段
    oidc_id_token_value TEXT COMMENT 'OIDC ID令牌值(JWT格式)',
    oidc_id_token_issued_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT 'OIDC ID令牌签发时间',
    oidc_id_token_expires_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT 'OIDC ID令牌过期时间',
    oidc_id_token_metadata TEXT COMMENT 'OIDC ID令牌元数据(JSON)',
    
    -- 刷新令牌相关字段
    refresh_token_value TEXT COMMENT '刷新令牌值',
    refresh_token_issued_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '刷新令牌签发时间',
    refresh_token_expires_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '刷新令牌过期时间(通常7天)',
    refresh_token_metadata TEXT COMMENT '刷新令牌元数据(JSON)',
    
    -- 设备授权流相关字段(Device Authorization Flow)
    user_code_value TEXT COMMENT '用户码值(8位短码,用户输入)',
    user_code_issued_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '用户码签发时间',
    user_code_expires_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '用户码过期时间',
    user_code_metadata TEXT COMMENT '用户码元数据(JSON)',
    
    device_code_value TEXT COMMENT '设备码值(设备轮询使用)',
    device_code_issued_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '设备码签发时间',
    device_code_expires_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '设备码过期时间',
    device_code_metadata TEXT COMMENT '设备码元数据(JSON)',
    
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    INDEX idx_registered_client_id (registered_client_id),
    INDEX idx_principal_name (principal_name),
    INDEX idx_authorization_code_value (authorization_code_value(255)),
    INDEX idx_access_token_value (access_token_value(255)),
    INDEX idx_refresh_token_value (refresh_token_value(255)),
    INDEX idx_access_token_expires_at (access_token_expires_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='OAuth2授权记录表(存储授权码、Token等)'

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_token_health AS
SELECT 
    DATE(access_token_issued_at) as issue_date,
    COUNT(*) as total_tokens,
    SUM(CASE WHEN access_token_encrypted IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as encrypted_tokens,
    SUM(CASE WHEN revoked_at IS NULL AND access_token_expires_at > NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_tokens,
    SUM(CASE WHEN revoked_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as revoked_tokens,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rotation_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rotated_tokens,
    AVG(rotation_count) as avg_rotation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT token_family) as active_families
FROM oauth2_authorization
WHERE access_token_issued_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE(access_token_issued_at)
ORDER BY issue_date DESC

DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS `initialize_default_tenant`

DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE `initialize_default_tenant`()
BEGIN
    DECLARE v_tenant_count INT DEFAULT 0
DECLARE v_other_tenant_count INT DEFAULT 0
DECLARE v_admin_count INT DEFAULT 0
DECLARE v_unassigned_user_count INT DEFAULT 0
DECLARE v_unassigned_dept_count INT DEFAULT 0
DECLARE v_root_conflict_count INT DEFAULT 0
DECLARE v_unassigned_role_count INT DEFAULT 0
DECLARE v_unassigned_role_dept_count INT DEFAULT 0
DECLARE v_tenant_id BIGINT DEFAULT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_tenant_count
    FROM `sys_tenant`
    WHERE `tenant_code` = 'apex-default' AND `deleted` = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_other_tenant_count
    FROM `sys_tenant`
    WHERE `tenant_code` <> 'apex-default' AND `deleted` = 0

IF v_other_tenant_count > 0 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
            SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'V44 cannot initialize apex-default while another active tenant exists'
END IF

IF v_tenant_count > 1 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
            SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'V44 found duplicate active apex-default tenants'
END IF

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_admin_count
    FROM `sys_user`
    WHERE `username` = 'admin' AND `deleted` = 0 AND `status` = 1

IF v_admin_count <> 1 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
            SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'V44 requires exactly one active admin user'
END IF

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_unassigned_user_count
    FROM `sys_user`
    WHERE `deleted` = 0
      AND (`tenant_id` IS NULL OR `tenant_id` = '')
      AND NOT (`username` = 'admin' AND `status` = 1)

IF v_unassigned_user_count > 0 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
            SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'V44 found unassigned non-admin users and cannot infer their tenant'
END IF

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_root_conflict_count
    FROM `sys_dept`
    WHERE `id` = 1
      AND NOT (`parent_id` = 0 AND `ancestors` = '0' AND `name` = 'Apex 科技')

IF v_root_conflict_count > 0 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
            SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'V44 cannot safely use department id 1 as the default root'
END IF

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_unassigned_dept_count
    FROM `sys_dept`
    WHERE `tenant_id` IS NULL OR `tenant_id` = ''

IF v_unassigned_dept_count > 0 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
            SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'V44 found unassigned departments and cannot infer their tenant'
END IF

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_unassigned_role_count
    FROM `sys_user_role` ur
    INNER JOIN `sys_user` u ON u.`id` = ur.`user_id`
    WHERE ur.`deleted` = 0
      AND (ur.`tenant_id` IS NULL OR ur.`tenant_id` = '')
      AND NOT (u.`username` = 'admin' AND u.`status` = 1)

IF v_unassigned_role_count > 0 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
            SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'V44 found unassigned roles for non-admin users'
END IF

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_unassigned_role_dept_count
    FROM `sys_role_dept` rd
    LEFT JOIN `sys_dept` d ON d.`id` = rd.`dept_id`
    WHERE rd.`deleted` = 0
      AND (rd.`tenant_id` IS NULL OR rd.`tenant_id` = '')
      AND (d.`tenant_id` IS NULL OR d.`tenant_id` <> 'apex-default')

IF v_unassigned_role_dept_count > 0 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
            SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'V44 found ambiguous role department tenant assignments'
END IF

IF v_tenant_count = 0 THEN
        INSERT INTO `sys_tenant`
            (`id`, `tenant_code`, `tenant_name`, `status`, `create_time`, `update_time`, `version`, `deleted`)
        VALUES
            (v_tenant_id, 'apex-default', 'Apex 默认租户', 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0)

ELSE
        SELECT `id` INTO v_tenant_id
        FROM `sys_tenant`
        WHERE `tenant_code` = 'apex-default' AND `deleted` = 0
        LIMIT 1

UPDATE `sys_tenant`
        SET `tenant_name` = 'Apex 默认租户', `status` = 'ACTIVE', `update_time` = NOW()
        WHERE `id` = v_tenant_id
END IF

INSERT INTO `sys_dept`
        (`id`, `parent_id`, `ancestors`, `name`, `order_num`, `status`, `tenant_id`, `create_time`, `update_time`, `version`, `deleted`)
    SELECT 1, 0, '0', 'Apex 科技', 1, 1, 'apex-default', NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `sys_dept` WHERE `id` = 1)

UPDATE `sys_user`
    SET `tenant_id` = 'apex-default', `dept_id` = 1, `update_time` = NOW()
    WHERE `username` = 'admin' AND `deleted` = 0 AND `status` = 1

UPDATE `sys_user_role` ur
    INNER JOIN `sys_user` u ON u.`id` = ur.`user_id`
    SET ur.`tenant_id` = 'apex-default', ur.`update_time` = NOW()
    WHERE u.`username` = 'admin' AND u.`deleted` = 0 AND u.`status` = 1

UPDATE `sys_role_dept`
    SET `tenant_id` = 'apex-default', `update_time` = NOW()
    WHERE (`tenant_id` IS NULL OR `tenant_id` = '') AND `dept_id` = 1

INSERT INTO `sys_role_dept`
        (`id`, `role_id`, `dept_id`, `tenant_id`, `create_time`, `update_time`, `version`, `deleted`)
    SELECT base.max_id + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ur.`role_id`), ur.`role_id`, 1, 'apex-default', NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0
    FROM `sys_user_role` ur
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(`id`), 0) AS max_id FROM `sys_role_dept`) base
    INNER JOIN `sys_user` u ON u.`id` = ur.`user_id`
    WHERE u.`username` = 'admin'
      AND ur.`tenant_id` = 'apex-default'
      AND ur.`deleted` = 0
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM `sys_role_dept` rd
          WHERE rd.`role_id` = ur.`role_id`
            AND rd.`dept_id` = 1
            AND rd.`tenant_id` = 'apex-default'
            AND rd.`deleted` = 0
      )

UPDATE `sys_tenant` t
    INNER JOIN `sys_user` u ON u.`username` = 'admin' AND u.`tenant_id` = 'apex-default'
    SET t.`admin_user_id` = CAST(u.`id` AS CHAR), t.`update_time` = NOW()
    WHERE t.`tenant_code` = 'apex-default' AND t.`deleted` = 0

END//
DELIMITER
CALL `initialize_default_tenant`()

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sys_message_outbox` (
  -- 主键与标识
  `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键ID',
  `message_id` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '消息唯一标识(全局唯一,雪花算法生成)',
  
  -- 消息路由信息
  `topic` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'RocketMQ Topic主题',
  `tag` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'RocketMQ Tag标签,用于消息过滤',
  `payload` LONGTEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '消息体JSON载荷,业务数据',
  `message_type` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BUSINESS_MESSAGE' 
    COMMENT '消息类型:DOMAIN_EVENT(领域事件)/BUSINESS_MESSAGE(业务消息)',
  
  -- 状态管理
  `status` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' 
    COMMENT '消息状态:PENDING(待投递)/PROCESSING(投递中)/DELIVERED(已投递)/DEAD(死信)',
  
  -- 重试控制
  `attempts` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '已尝试投递次数',
  `max_attempts` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 COMMENT '最大尝试次数,超过后进入死信',
  `next_attempt_at` DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) 
    COMMENT '下次尝试时间,支持延迟投递',
  `retry_delay_seconds` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10 
    COMMENT '重试延迟基数(秒),实际延迟=基数*2^(attempts-1),指数退避',
  
  -- 分布式锁
  `locked_by` VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '锁定实例ID(UUID),防止多实例并发投递',
  `locked_at` DATETIME(6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '锁定时间,用于检测过期锁',
  `lock_timeout_seconds` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 300 COMMENT '锁超时时间(秒),默认5分钟',
  
  -- 错误追踪
  `last_error` VARCHAR(1000) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '最近一次投递失败的错误信息',
  
  -- 租户隔离
  `tenant_id` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '租户ID,实现多租户数据隔离',
  
  -- 审计字段
  `created_at` DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) COMMENT '消息创建时间',
  `updated_at` DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) 
    ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) COMMENT '最后更新时间',
  `delivered_at` DATETIME(6) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '投递成功时间',
  
  -- 主键与唯一约束
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_message_id` (`message_id`),
  
  -- 性能索引
  KEY `idx_dispatch` (`status`, `next_attempt_at`, `tenant_id`) 
    COMMENT '调度查询索引:查询待投递消息',
  KEY `idx_locked` (`status`, `locked_at`, `locked_by`) 
    COMMENT '锁管理索引:查询和释放过期锁',
  KEY `idx_tenant` (`tenant_id`, `created_at`) 
    COMMENT '租户查询索引:按租户查询消息历史'
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci 
COMMENT='消息发件箱表-Outbox模式实现本地消息表'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sys_user_social` (
  `id`          BIGINT       NOT NULL COMMENT '主键ID(雪花算法)',
  `tenant_id`   VARCHAR(64)  DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '租户ID(多租户隔离)',
  `user_id`     BIGINT       NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID(sys_user.id)',
  `channel`     VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL COMMENT '社交渠道(WECHAT_APP/WECHAT_MINI/WECHAT_MP)',
  `open_id`     VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '该渠道下的OpenID',
  `union_id`    VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '微信UnionID',
  `status`      INT(1)       NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '状态(0-解绑,1-正常)',
  `bound_at`    DATETIME     NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '绑定时间',
  `create_time` DATETIME     NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
  `update_time` DATETIME     NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间',
  `version`     INT(10)      NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '版本号(乐观锁)',
  `deleted`     INT(1)       NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '逻辑删除(0-未删,1-已删)',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  -- 渠道+OpenID 唯一：同一渠道同一微信身份只能绑定一个用户
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_channel_openid` (`channel`, `open_id`),
  KEY `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_union_id` (`union_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户社交身份绑定表(多端微信OpenID)'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sys_domain_event_outbox (
  id BIGINT NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
  event_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  event_class VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

-- payload: 事件 JSON 负载，包含事件携带的全部业务数据。
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,

-- PENDING: 待投递 / PROCESSING: 投递中 / DELIVERED: 已投递 / DEAD: 死信。
  status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',

-- attempts: 已失败重试次数，达到上限后移入 DEAD。
  attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

-- next_attempt_at: 指数退避后的下次重试时间点。
  next_attempt_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),

-- locked_by: 投递实例的唯一标识（如实例 ID），用于多实例互斥领取。
  locked_by VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL,

  locked_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT NULL,

-- last_error: 最近一次投递失败的错误摘要（脱敏后），用于故障排查。
  last_error VARCHAR(1000) DEFAULT NULL,

  created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),

-- delivered_at: 投递成功完成后记录，用于判断事件投递延迟。
  delivered_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT NULL,

  PRIMARY KEY (id),

-- event_id 全局唯一，防止同一事件重复写入。
  CONSTRAINT uk_outbox_event_id UNIQUE (event_id)
-- 调度器核心查询：按状态和下次尝试时间领取待投递事件。
-- id 作为第三列确保相同优先级事件按 FIFO 顺序处理。

-- 定位超时未完成的事件（locked 状态过久，需重新调度）。
)

CREATE VIEW v_token_health AS
SELECT DATE(access_token_issued_at) AS issue_date,
    COUNT(*) AS total_tokens,
    SUM(CASE WHEN access_token_encrypted IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS encrypted_tokens,
    SUM(CASE WHEN revoked_at IS NULL AND access_token_expires_at > NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_tokens,
    SUM(CASE WHEN revoked_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS revoked_tokens,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rotation_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rotated_tokens,
    AVG(rotation_count) AS avg_rotation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT token_family) AS active_families
FROM oauth2_authorization
WHERE access_token_issued_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY DATE(access_token_issued_at)
ORDER BY issue_date DESC

    `remark`              VARCHAR(500)          DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备注',
    `create_time`         DATETIME     NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',

    `deleted`             TINYINT      NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '逻辑删除标识（0-未删除 1-已删除）',
    PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
    KEY `idx_wf_approval_instance` (`process_instance_id`),
    KEY `idx_wf_approval_task` (`task_id`),

    KEY `idx_wf_approval_create_time` (`create_time`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='审批记录表'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wf_approval_record (
    id                  BIGINT       NOT NULL,
    tenant_id           VARCHAR(64)  NOT NULL,
    process_instance_id BIGINT       NOT NULL,
    task_id             BIGINT       NOT NULL,
    node_code           VARCHAR(100),
    approver_id         BIGINT,
    action              VARCHAR(20),
    opinion             VARCHAR(1000),
    remark              VARCHAR(500),
    create_time         TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    update_time         TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    deleted             SMALLINT     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_wf_approval_instance ON wf_approval_record (process_instance_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_wf_approval_task ON wf_approval_record (task_id)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_wf_approval_create_time ON wf_approval_record (create_time)

COMMENT ON COLUMN wf_approval_record.opinion IS '处理意见'
